card.name: Route of use: 'for subcutaneous use only'
card.fires_on: The word 'use' right after a route such as subcutaneous or topical in 'is for ___ use only' statements. It also fires on the end of a word in short label instructions, such as 'Ca-ution' or 'Disc-ard'.

modes.label: Route then 'use'
modes.description: The word 'use' after subcutaneous, topical or intraocular in a route-restriction sentence.
modes.example: KEYTRUDA QLEX is for subcutaneous<< use>> in the thigh or abdomen only.

modes.label: Ends of instruction words
modes.description: The last piece of a short instruction or precaution word near the start of a sentence.
